text:
mira: Quick design review — I'm trying two breadcrumb/side-nav behaviours for deep links to items inside collapsed groups. Need product/eng/accessibility takes.
sam: Sketch or notes?
mira: Added two gifs to the Figma file + comments. TL;DR: Option A expands the parent group on load and highlights the leaf. Option B keeps the sidebar collapsed but surfaces a breadcrumb strip above the content with parent > child, and a small badge on the parent. Wrote pros/cons in comments.
jorge: I prefer A for discoverability, but worried about layout jump when the group expands on load, especially on small screens.
kevin: Could avoid jump by rendering server/client with expanded state (render expanded from the start) so there's no visible reflow. That means the initial render needs to know the path mapping.
ava: Accessibility nits: if we auto-expand you MUST manage focus. Either move focus to the expanded group header or the leaf item and mark aria-current on the leaf. Also announce via a polite live region on deep-link landing: "You arrived at X > Y".
mira: Agreed. For A I'm proposing we render expanded state (no animation) and programmatically focus the leaf with tabindex=-1 then element.focus() only when the landing context indicates keyboard arrival. For B: keep collapsed nav, but breadcrumb buttons must be keyboard-focusable and have aria-controls to open the group in-place.
sam: Routing question — should canonical URLs change when we expand? e.g. should deep linking rewrite to a canonical "expanded" URL, or keep the original leaf path? Redirects are meh for SPA.
jorge: Implementation idea: keep canonical path as the leaf/target path (no extra query param). On load the client reads location and sets nav expansion state accordingly. No server redirect, no URL mutation unless a migration requires it.
kevin: Also: fallback for moved/renamed items — show a non-blocking banner "Item moved to X" with a link; avoid returning a hard 404 for common reorgs.
ava: Extra edge-case: screen-reader users landing mid-list need immediate context. We should add a visually-hidden H1 like "Location: Projects > AcmeCorp > Members" and assert it via aria-live so AT announces it on load.
mira: I'll prototype A with zero-jump expand + aria-live summary. I'll also prototype B as an optional "compact nav" toggle in settings so power users can keep nav collapsed.
sam: :thumbsup: Timeline — can we have a dev-ready spec before sprint planning?
jorge: I can spike this week: small PR that maps route -> expansion state and a util to apply expansion to the nav tree. Example mapping in the PR notes:```js
// example route -> expanded groups
"/workspaces/alpha/apps/payroll/settings/team/jane": {
  expand: ["workspaces", "alpha", "apps", "payroll"],
  active: "team/jane"
}
```
kevin: Ping me when PR's up. I'll check perf on large trees (render cost + initial paint) and review the no-jump approach. Also recommend adding an integration test for deep-link load + focus behaviour.
mira: Thanks — added a checklist to the Figma comments. @ava can you add a short screen-reader QA script (3-4 steps) for the prototype? I'll update microcopy for breadcrumbs and the moved-item banner.
ava: Will do, will share SR QA steps by EOD. Also suggest copy for the banner: "This item moved to [new location]." with a "Take me there" CTA. Keep it short.
mira: Great — iterating on the prototype now. Will post links to the two GIFs and a short demo video here when ready. nav-bot: Deploy preview created at https://deploy.preview/2145123456 — comments welcome.
sam: Awesome, thanks team.
